title: Shipments and refills
body: Refills are sent on a recurring cycle as long as you have refills remaining on your current prescription and your subscription is active.
Prescriptions are written for a set number of shipments. When those run out, you'll need a follow-up visit with your provider before another prescription can be written.
You book follow-up visits yourself from your account. We'll remind you when one is due.
If a package is delayed, marked delivered but missing, or arrives damaged, tell us and we'll open a case and get a replacement moving.
